review_scope: Bounded follow-up of the known CGK host-estate locator defect using independently public issuer financial statements, a public landowner masterplan, and an Indonet shareholder disclosure. This is research only: no frozen source, selected geometry, contract, release artifact or admission changes.

candidate.name: Digital Edge CGK Campus
candidate.inherited_geometry_finding: The selected inherited polygon describes the whole GIIC host estate, not the CGK campus. Its centroid is not an exact campus point. This known error still requires an explicit versioned correction before a coherent verified 200-site completion claim; preserving archived bytes does not resolve it.

new_findings.source_locator: PDF page 63, printed page 60, note 31 Revenues continuation; cover on PDF page 1
new_findings.finding: The land developer's consolidated statements explicitly name PT Digital Gayana Ekagrata in the table of customers exceeding ten percent of sales. This independently supports a commercial relationship with the exact legal entity already bridged to the Bekasi campus by the prior legal-adviser disclosure. The customer table supplies no plot number, land-certificate identifier, coordinates or campus boundary. It does not establish which particular land transaction or parcel belongs to CGK.
new_findings.review_method: All 85 pages were text-screened for the legal entity and land, certificate, parcel and location terms. Complete PDF pages 1 and 63 were rendered and visually checked. No exact CGK parcel was found in that bounded screen.
new_findings.date_policy: March 31 is an accounting date, not a construction observation or publication date. Neither the May URL directory nor PDF modification metadata is substituted for publication. No lifecycle or capacity metric is selected.

new_findings.source_locator: The public Masterplan page's linked 1024 by 577 pixel JPG, inspected in full at its native size
new_findings.finding: The estate-wide land-use illustration contains industrial, residential and commercial zones, roads and small plot labels. No legible CGK or Digital Gayana Ekagrata tenant-to-plot bridge or numeric georeferencing controls are established by this image. A north arrow and scale do not supply an identified source CRS or a campus locator. No geometry was traced or georeferenced from it.
new_findings.date_policy: HTML publication and modification timestamps are not the map's surveyed date or a construction observation. The older image directory is not a tenant occupancy date.

new_findings.source_locator: PDF page 9, subsidiaries table; publication statement on PDF page 1
new_findings.finding: The shareholder disclosure lists Digital Gayana Ekaprana, Digital Gayana Ekagrata and Ekagrata Data Gemilang as separate subsidiaries. Jakarta entries in this table are corporate domiciles, not facility locations. They do not establish a CGK parcel. The issuer's cover address is likewise not a CGK locator.
new_findings.review_method: All 15 pages were text-screened for the legal entity and land/address/location terms. Complete PDF pages 1 and 9 were rendered and visually checked. Shareholder identities and personal details are not projected into this packet.
new_findings.date_policy: The cover explicitly states publication on March 16, 2026. This is not a physical-construction observation.

candidate.next_missing_gate: A freely accessible operator-issued CGK-specific numeric point, or an official cadastral/permit plan explicitly binding CGK and PT Digital Gayana Ekagrata to a precise parcel with source coordinate semantics and CRS. A certificate number or named tenant-to-plot link could open that route. Once established, prepare a versioned correction preserving the archived baseline and unrelated rows, then rerun full-geometry and alias review.

excluded_routes.finding: The publicly linked presentation opens with explicit confidentiality and redistribution/use restrictions. This route was stopped: no local raw capture, substantive projection, map extraction or selected evidence from the presentation is included. The independently public financial statement and website masterplan were assessed separately.

Secondary GAIA/CGK construction labels do not establish an authoritative identity bridge to the selected CGK1 campus or an exact parcel. No personal-profile information or speculative alias is selected.

The previously documented operator specification-sheet form remains out of scope. No personal/contact information was submitted and no gated document was obtained. Prior estate centroids and corporate-office pins remain rejected.

baseline_review.spatial_clearance: No replacement geometry was established, so no new overlap or distance clearance is claimed. CGK is already represented and its correction cannot add a distinct site.
